# External Research Archive

Store external research here unchanged before synthesis.

For each research run, create a dated directory containing:

- the exact prompt;
- the complete raw response;
- model/version and run date if available;
- browsing/source list;
- exported attachments or tables;
- a checksum or immutable source copy where practical.

Do not overwrite or “clean up” the raw answer. Corrections and comparison belong in `../04-pro-research-comparison-template.md` and `../05-claim-ledger.md`.
